text:
jordan_cust: Hey team — started seeing a big spike of 429s around 2025-11-03 10:12 UTC. This is our production embed pipeline (single API key, free tier). No X-RateLimit-Reset header in the responses, so we can't schedule retries properly. Impacting nightly ingestion. Sample response:

jordan_cust: ```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
{
  \"error\": {\"message\": \"rate limit exceeded\", \"type\": \"server_error\"}
}
```

jordan_cust: and our call is like:

jordan_cust: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{\"model\":\"embed-large\",\"input\":[\"...large batch of docs...\"]}'
```

sam_support: Sorry you're blocked — thanks for the details. A couple quick q's: 1) are you on the free plan or a trial? 2) approx concurrency/requests-per-second when the spike happened? 3) any request_id from the response headers? If you don't have the reset header we'll try a temporary uplift while we investigate.

jordan_cust: Free plan. We were running ~35 concurrent embedding requests, spikes to ~60 QPS when the worker pool restarted. No request_id in headers either.

sam_support: Got it. Immediate suggestions while we investigate: reduce concurrency to ~8-10, add exponential backoff (retry with jitter), and if possible split large batches into smaller batches. I can also request a temporary capacity bump from sales for 24 hours. Do you want that now?

jordan_cust: Yes please — we can't rotate the key right now because it's deployed across many pods. A 24h bridge would be great so we can smooth the rollout.

marta_billing: @sam_support tagging billing — please note customer on free tier asking for 24h uplift. We need sales signoff for any manual capacity changes that exceed free-tier allowances.

lee_sales: Looping in sales. Hi @jordan_cust — we can provision a short-term paid uplift (manual override) to avoid 429s while you stabilize. Can you DM me the expected sustained QPS and desired duration? Also preferred billing contact so I can expedite the paperwork.

ravi_eng_oncall: Quick production tip: embeddings are heavy on token throughput. If you can: a) enable local prefix caching, b) batch_size -> 8-16, c) ensure workers use long backoff windows for retries. Example config we recommend:

ravi_eng_oncall: ```yaml
parallel_requests: 8
batch_size: 16
retry_policy:
  base_delay_ms: 300
  max_delay_ms: 5000
  max_attempts: 6
```

sam_support: Update: I requested a 24h temporary uplift. Pending sales/billing approval. I've opened a support task (internal) and added eng_oncall to troubleshoot root cause. I will also ask infra to check if the free-plan throttle rules logged anything unusual at 10:12 UTC.

marta_billing: billing-bot: Please confirm customer contact and invoice route. If they convert to paid we'll process a short-term invoice for the uplift window. billing-bot: https://billing.redwood.ai/portal/invoice/quick-uplift

lee_sales: I can approve a short-term uplift while we sort billing. Jordan — can you confirm target steady-state QPS (not peaks)? If you can sustain ~20 QPS we can move you to a small paid tier; if you need burst capacity, we can add an hourly burst addon.

jordan_cust: Steady state target ~18 QPS, peaks up to 60 for a few minutes. We'll implement Ravi's batching config this afternoon.

sam_support: Approved: temporary +50% concurrency uplift for the next 6 hours while sales finalizes the 24h uplift. Change logged and will auto-revert. Expires at 1735058070 (6h).

deploy-bot: Uplift change recorded by @sam_support — audit id uplift-1735054321-01

jordan_cust: Thanks everyone — we'll monitor and report back. If 429s persist after batching we'll need the 24h window.

lee_sales: I'll DM you now to collect billing contact. We can fast-track a 24h paid uplift if needed.

sam_support: Follow-up action items: 1) customer to implement batching + backoff (jordan_cust) 2) eng to check throttle logs and report request patterns (ravi_eng_oncall) 3) sales to confirm uplift invoice and duration (lee_sales). Please add any missing items.

jordan_cust: adding: I'll also deploy a temporary feature flag to cap concurrency at 10 until we finish rollout.

sam_support: Great — marking as in progress. React with :thumbsup: when done.
